title: Images and citations should be on by default for every Papyrus site
description: Ryan, 2026-11-04: images should be enabled in Papyrus by default. Today a site's web/projection.json must declare images and citations, or the projector has no image pipeline. On Machines on Machines, saving a Story with ::image lines succeeded (the save path uses its own pipeline), and only publish failed: data published, page not live, with MarkusValidationError Unknown directive 'image'. Of the sites checked, only Anth.us sets them; Pilobolus, Shipped and Distinctive don't, so their first Story with a picture will fail the same way. Fix: default both on, with a site able to turn them off, and make save and publish agree so a problem can't first appear at publish. Also: revalidation in the same publish reported that PAPYRUS_PUBLIC_SITE_BASE_URL or publicSite.baseUrl is required on the signed-in lane.
